title: 축산자조금의 조성 및 운용에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:11:0:00011:part:1/1
title_original: 축산자조금의 조성 및 운용에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 11 (Refund Procedure for Overpayment)
① Refunds of overpayments as stipulated in Article 20 of the Act must be made within 1 month from the date the livestock farmer requests the refund or the committee confirms the overpayment. The committee must also verify overpayments on a semi-annual basis.
② When the committee refunds overpayments as described in Article 1, it must notify the collecting agency of the refund details.
